H9001.definition: Verbal vav: joined to verb with no intervening prefix (usually conversive) (futurepast)

H9002.definition: Conjunctive vav - i.e. followed by prefix, suffix or non-verb (conjunctive) (‘and/but’)

H9008.definition: Prefix hé interrogative: at the start of a question

H9009.definition: Prefix hé article: "the" for a subject, not object

H9010.definition: Suffix aleph: definite article "the" in Aramaic

H9018.definition: Punctuation Sameq paragraph: ends a lectionary section

H9019.definition: Punctuation Inverted Nun paragraph: ends a lectionary section
